restrictions: Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with exactly 1 prefix round in the single root compression; 64-byte messages, one chunk, block length 64, counter 0, flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT=11, standard IV, full 256-bit root output.

Charged time includes construction (at most 176 ordinary operations), deterministic verification by two complete 1-round recomputations plus message-inequality and digest-equality checks; total below 4 target compressions.
Peak memory below 2^15 bytes including code, constants, messages, state and scratch; memory is reported separately and scores nothing.
data_log2 bounds complete input bytes hashed including verification (256 bytes); preprocessing is zero with all work online; nonuniform advice is zero.

Analytic exact construction with explicit messages verifiable by verifier/blake3.py:blake3; no heuristic, no experiment, no stored precomputed collision beyond the constructed pair; qualification requires fresh review.
